PowerShell Cheat Sheet

Searchable reference of 90+ real PowerShell cmdlets with descriptions and aliases.

CmdletAliasCategoryDescription

📖 How to use

  1. Type in the search box to filter cmdlets instantly.
  2. Use the category dropdown to browse one area.
  3. Click a row to copy the cmdlet name.
  4. All entries are real cmdlets — verify with Get-Help.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How many cmdlets are listed?

Over 90 real cmdlets across file system, processes, services, network, web, data and more.

What do the aliases mean?

Short built-in aliases shown in the alias column — e.g. gci for Get-ChildItem.

Does this work for PowerShell 7?

Yes — the listed cmdlets exist in Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7 unless noted.

Can I copy a cmdlet?

Click any row to copy the cmdlet name to your clipboard.
